result.summary: Several layout and content issues: a category chip is clipped, a restaurant name is truncated, and delivery time text is overlapping on a popular listing.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text overlaps itself, showing garbled content like '25-30elivery' instead of a readable time and fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the overlapping/stacked text layers so delivery time and fee display as separate, fully visible labels (e.g. '25–30 min · €0 delivery').

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped on the right, cutting off the name 'Trattoria Piccol' and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal cards have enough padding or peek correctly without truncating names; allow wrapping or a fade/ellipsis that still keeps the name identifiable.

issues.description: The category filter row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and next chip), so users cannot see the full set of filters.
issues.suggestion: Add scroll affordance or ensure the last visible chip isn’t clipped mid-control; keep consistent end padding.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is cut off by the tab bar, hiding restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so cards aren’t obscured by the navigation bar.
